title: NDC-3028 bulk Close on the whole view (60 tickets)
rows: Screen: Select all 60 in this view › Close › Close 60 tickets → POST /desk/tickets/bulk/close × 3 (25 + 25 + 10 ids)
200 × 3: succeeded 25/25/10, failed 0 (last batch back ~88 s after the click). Toast "60 records closed."
200 × 3, every result ok:false ALREADY_CLOSED "The ticket is already closed." Toast "0 closed, 60 already closed."
Runs 1–3: page reloaded ~35–60 s after the click
Only the batches already sent ran: 25/60, then 53/60, then 36/60 closed. No progress shown while it works (~90 s for 60).
